items.raw_excerpt: NEW YORK, Sept 13 : Trinity Rodman pulled off a logistical miracle on Sunday, making the 200-mile trip from a soccer pitch in Washington to Arthur Ashe Stadium in New York, only to arrive in time to watch boyfriend Ben Shelton lose the U.S. Open final to Alexander Zverev.The U.S. women's national soccer team
items.summary_en: Trinity Rodman drove 200 miles from a soccer game in Washington to New York. She arrived just in time to see her boyfriend Ben Shelton lose the US Open final to Alexander Zverev. She was called Shelton's lucky charm but it did not work.
items.summary_ko: 트리니티 로드먼은 워싱턴 축구 경기장에서 뉴욕까지 320킬로미터를 달려 갔습니다. 도착했을 때는 남자친구 벤 셸턴이 저베르에게 미국 오픈 결승에서 패하는 모습을 보기 직전이었습니다. 셸턴의 행운의 부적이라 불렸지만 이번에는 통하지 않았습니다.
items.title_en: Trinity Rodman travels 200 miles from soccer pitch to watch boyfriend in US Open final
items.title_ko: 축구 경기 마치고 320킬로미터 달려 온 로드먼, 남자친구 결승은 아쉽게 패배
items.title_original: Rodman makes late entrance but Shelton's lucky charm misses mark

items.raw_excerpt: Auckland's City Rail Link has had its first full weekday in operation on Monday after a busy Sunday opening, and some businesses are already gearing up for opening an extra day in anticipation of more customers.
items.summary_en: Auckland's City Rail Link ran its first full weekday on Monday after a busy Sunday opening. Train passenger numbers jumped 38 percent. Some businesses are already planning to open an extra day to serve more customers.

items.raw_excerpt: Luego de cerrar una medialuna irregular, alcalde de Peñalolén acusó al Gobierno de apoyar
items.summary_en: The mayor of Peñalolén, a community near Santiago, Chile, accused the national government of supporting clandestine rodeo practices. The criticism came after officials shut down an irregular medialuna, the crescent-shaped ring used in traditional Chilean rodeo. The dispute highlights tensions between cultural tradition and local regulation.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 산티아고 근처 페냐롤렌 시장이 정부가 불법 rodeo 활동을 지원하고 있다고 비판했다. 이번 발언은 전통 칠레 rodeo 경기장인 메디아루나의 불법 시설이 폐쇄된 뒤 나왔다. 지역 전통과 규제 사이의 갈등이 다시 한번 드러났다.
items.title_en: Mayor Accuses Chilean Government of Backing Underground Rodeo Practices
items.title_ko: 페냐롤렌 시장, 칠레 정부의 비밀 rodeo 지원 비판
items.title_original: Defensa del rodeo: Alcalde de Peñalolén acusó al Gobierno de apoyar "prácticas clandestinas"

items.summary_en: Chilean club Santiago Wanderers will play against Real Madrid at Santiago Bernabéu stadium in Madrid. The Under-20 Intercontinental Cup match features young players from both teams.

items.raw_excerpt: Em sua primeira final de Grand Slam na categoria até 90 quilios, o brasileiro derrotou o sérvio Boris Rutovic ao definir o embate com um ippon. Brasil também conquistou prata com Kaillany Cardoso (-70kg) e bronze com Sarah Souza (-57kg).
items.summary_en: Brazilian judoka Guilherme Schimidt won gold in his first Grand Slam final in the up to 90kg category. He defeated Serbian Boris Rutovic with an ippon. Brazil also won silver and bronze in other weight classes.

items.title_en: Guilherme Schimidt wins gold as Brazil closes Grand Slam judo with 3 podiums

items.title_original: Guilherme Schimidt é ouro e país fecha Grand Slam de judô com 3 pódios

items.raw_excerpt: Almost 70 per cent of public housing tenants in Western Australia's remote Kimberley region are waiting on urgent repairs, research has found.
items.summary_en: Almost 70 per cent of public housing tenants in the Kimberley region are waiting on urgent repairs. A new report highlights chronic maintenance failures in Western Australia's far north. The research draws attention to the lack of housing upkeep in remote areas.

items.raw_excerpt: Landholders fear the Macquarie Marshes feral pig problem could make a bird flu outbreak harder to contain as concerns grow about the potential impact on the internationally recognised wetlands.

items.raw_excerpt: CJP to join protests demanding MPSC officials' resignation over alleged exam paper leaks, supporting students' fight for transparency.
items.summary_en: Student protesters are demanding the resignation of Maharashtra Public Service Commission officials over alleged exam paper leaks. The protests aim to bring transparency to the examination process. CJP joins the student movement to support accountability.

items.raw_excerpt: La actividad se desarrolló con apoyo del buque patrullero médico dental Cirujano Videla, oficiales de la Reserva Naval del área de salud y del Servicio de Salud de Reloncaví y el municipio. Contempló visita a hogares de ancianos y trabajos de reparación en la escuela Arturo Prat.
items.summary_en: The Chilean Navy sent a medical-dental patrol ship to the small town of Chaitén for a civic health operation. Officers visited elderly care homes and repaired the Arturo Prat school. The event served nearly 500 patients in total.

items.raw_excerpt: H5 bird flu has been detected for the first time in an Australian pelican, as another suspected case is reported in a sea lion off the Victor Harbor coast.
items.summary_en: H5 bird flu was found in a pelican for the first time. A suspected case was also reported in a sea lion off the Victor Harbor coast.

items.raw_excerpt: Wellington City Council has apologised for spending over $600,000 on a website to draw visitors to the newly reopened City Library.
items.summary_en: Wellington City Council apologised for spending over $600,000 on a website to promote its newly reopened City Library. The council admitted the cost was excessive and said it would review how such projects are managed.

items.raw_excerpt: Conheça o complexo de templos cerâmicos no Recife, uma antiga fábrica de tijolos de 1945 transformada em museu a céu aberto na mata.
items.summary_en: A brick factory that stopped working in 1945 has been turned into an open-air museum in Recife, Brazil. The site is called the Ceramic Temples Complex and sits hidden in the forest. Visitors can walk among the old structures and explore the art and history of the place.
items.summary_ko: 레시페 숲속에 자리 잡은 1945년 폐업 벽돌 공장이 야외 박물관으로 변신했다. 도예 사원 콤플렉스라 불리는 이곳은 숲에 숨겨진 독특한 문화 공간이다. 방문객은 오래된 건물 사이를 걸으며 예술과 역사를 만날 수 있다.
items.title_en: An Old Brick Factory From 1945 Now Stands as an Open-Air Museum in Recife
items.title_ko: 1945년 멈춘 벽돌 공장이 레시페에서 야외 박물관으로 탈바꿈하다
items.title_original: Uma fábrica de tijolos parada desde 1945 virou museu a céu aberto: o complexo de templos cerâmicos escondido na mata do Recife - Brasil 247

items.summary_en: A 23-year-old moved to the small village of Valdemoro-Sierra in 2023 and opened a bar called Haro in July 2025. She says success means not having to leave her village. Her inspiring story has been circulating in Spanish local news.

items.title_en: 23-year-old left Valencia to open a bar in a village of under 100 people
